stories.title: Singapore Open — Prozorova Walkover Controversy Puts Gibson in Final

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Talia Gibson is in the Singapore Open FINAL. Prozorova had to withdraw via concussion protocol after being struck in the face during doubles — but Prozorova is pushing back hard, saying she was "pressured" into withdrawing. WTA and player now in public dispute. 🎾 #WTASingapore

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Prozorova's statement on her withdrawal: the ball grazed her cheek and hit her shoulder. She says poor balance-test results were fatigue from 3 consecutive 3+ hour matches — not a concussion. WTA says protocol was followed correctly. A real controversy. #WTASingapore
